prompt: customer_analytics와 transaction_history를 customer_id로 내부 조인해서 조인 결과 행 개수와 컬럼 수를 보여줘

oracle.implementation: pandas.DataFrame.merge independent of production DuckDB join

dataset.query: SELECT COALESCE(l."customer_id", r."customer_id") AS "customer_id", l."age" AS "age", l."gender" AS "gender", l."job" AS "job", l."marital" AS "marital", l."education" AS "education", l."credit_score" AS "credit_score", l."annual_income" AS "annual_income", l."balance" AS "balance", l."housing_loan" AS "housing_loan", l."personal_loan" AS "personal_loan", l."signup_date" AS "signup_date", l."last_active_date" AS "last_active_date", l."device_type" AS "device_type", l."service_tier" AS "service_tier", l."churn" AS "churn", l."campaign_contact_count" AS "campaign_contact_count", l."satisfaction_score" AS "satisfaction_score", r."tx_id" AS "tx_id", r."tx_datetime" AS "tx_datetime", r."tx_type" AS "tx_type", r."amount" AS "amount", r."channel" AS "channel", r."is_declined" AS "is_declined", r."fee" AS "fee" FROM left_data AS l INNER JOIN right_data AS r ON l."customer_id" = r."customer_id"

limitations: Local fixture evaluation; no Databricks or browser execution
Validates an unambiguous inner join journey; many-to-many and output-limit rejection are unit contracts
